Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhopal Assistant Professor (Lecturer in Nursing) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 09-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Nursing from a recognized institution, be registered with the Indian Nursing Council/State Nursing Council, and have at least three years of teaching experience. A Ph.D. in Nursing is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant Professor (Lecturer in Nursing) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 50 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with all required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor (Lecturer in Nursing) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 111,040/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General and OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 1,000/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Assistant Professor (Lecturer in Nursing).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position.
